title: Stasis Lock Puzzle Realm
description: A top-down surreal scene shows a floating circular island platform with cracked light green ground, connected by a wooden dock over blue water and a stone bridge. Visible elements include a large clock tower with gears, a purple hexagonal platform with glowing runes, a treasure chest on a wooden platform, a mine cart on tracks, a small waterfall, and two silhouetted figures.
prompt: Top-down isometric view of a surreal floating island puzzle realm with cracked light green terrain and purple glowing fissures. Features a large ornate clock tower with visible gears, a purple hexagonal rune platform, a wooden dock over blue water, a stone arch bridge, a chained treasure chest, a mine cart on tracks, and a small waterfall cascading from an upper rocky platform.
